authorization: user explicitly authorized assistant recommendations and execution on 2026-08-11
seed_policy: same three hidden seed families at every depth; seeds never exposed to solver process

software.NOTALD: Ocean implementation-validation reference 0.1 (campaign code; not full ALD)
software.iProver: CASC-J13-2026 tag (resolved full commit recorded at run)

hardware.platform: GitHub Actions private repository hosted runner ubuntu-24.04
hardware.concurrency: serial solver evaluations within campaign job
hardware.note: actual uname/cpu/memory captured into run artifact

resources.global_expansion_accounting_rule: reference systems count graph-edge probes/expansions to first verified certificate; professional ATP internal inference records are secondary and not equated with Ocean edge expansions
resources.stopping_rule: first accepted verified conclusive certificate; otherwise BOUNDED_UNKNOWN at hard wall-clock or memory limit

artifact_bundle: independently verified certificates for those smaller-L siblings
training.predecessor_policy: all smaller-L siblings from all three seed families
training.reference_adapter_note: benchmark-specific Data/NOTALD reference adapters may not consume the offered training bundle; consumption is reported explicitly

normalization.double_negation_rule: classical normalization of NOTALD R target not(not(T_L)) to T_L before Ocean search

verification.instance_shortest_path_check: independent BFS on sealed graph outside solver process
verification.professional_certificate_policy: accept professional theorem claim only when proof output exposes named input edge axioms whose induced subgraph independently contains a source-to-target path; otherwise AUDIT_FAILURE
verification.native_ocean_proof_counting_convention: hypotheses free; each edge along verified source-to-target certificate path counts as one native Ocean inference

scoring.primary: fraction of instances with correct certified settlement within frozen budget
secondary: charged work to first accepted certificate
scoring.tie_rule: higher primary solve fraction; then lower median charged work on jointly solved instances where comparable; then lower median wall-clock; remaining ties reported as ties
scoring.unknown_handling: BOUNDED_UNKNOWN separate from logical failure and never treated as refutation/independence
